title: CRLR/173/2015 of Vishnu Prasad Saklani Vs Smt. Rekha Saklani

paras.text:
CRLR No.173 of 2015
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, Advocate present for
the revisionist.
An application was moved by the respondent-wife under Section 125 Cr.P.C. in which an order
for maintenance of Rs.1500/- per month has been
given in favour of the wife-respondent vide order
dated 25.04.2015 passed by Additional Judge,
Family Court, Rishikesh, District Dehradun in
Misc. Case No. 56 of 2014. Aggrieved, the present
revision has been filed by the revisionist-husband.
There is no occasion for any interference in
the matter as the maintenance amount is only
Rs.1500/- per month. Secondly, there still may be
chances for mediation and in case, such an
application for mediation is made before the court
below, the court below shall duly consider and shall
make effort for conciliation.
In view of the above direction, the Revision
stands disposed.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
30.06.2015
 JKJ
